description: Synthetic sesslint.batch-repair.v1 schema parity. Constraints and expected rejections come from the pinned schema. Documents are hand-built. BatchRepairReport.to_dict is not executed. No session text is stored.
known_parity_gaps: Schema path resolution and the missing-file loader are not this validator.
repair_many, CLI exit codes, and human rendering are not one schema result.
Count totals are derived by the emitter. Counts need not match the rows.
Duplicate JSON object keys are refused. Python json.loads keeps the last key.
A JSON number is an integer only when it is a proven i128.
pattern and length keywords are absent from the pinned schema and fail closed.
